sources.name: FEC candidate master file, 2025-2026 (cn26)
sources.notes: Pipe-delimited, no header row; columns per cn_header_file.csv. Includes CAND_ELECTION_YR other than 2026, filtered out. Lists every registrant; it does not indicate who qualified for the general election ballot.

sources.name: FEC all candidates financial summary, 2025-2026 (weball26)
sources.notes: Columns per https://www.fec.gov/campaign-finance-data/all-candidates-file-description/ (no header file is published; weball_header_file.csv returns 404). Totals cover the candidate's authorized committees for the two-year cycle through CVG_END_DT.
